issues.description: In PersonResource, the handler method for GET /persons (getAllPersons) is declared public in the template but private in the solution. This is an unnecessary deviation from standard Spring MVC controller conventions and can confuse students comparing their implementation to the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution method signature to `public ResponseEntity<List<Person>> getAllPersons()` to match the template (or change both to public for consistency).

issues.description: The problem statement refers to the integration test class as "PersonIntegrationTests" (plural) in the narrative, but the actual class/file provided in both template and solution is named "PersonIntegrationTest" (singular). This can mislead students into searching for or creating a differently named class.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the problem statement to consistently use the exact class name "PersonIntegrationTest" (singular).
